key_idea: The side length must divide every maximal horizontal and vertical run of '#', so only divisors of that gcd (at most ~40 values) need testing, and for a fixed side the tiling is forced: the first uncovered cell in row-major order must be a top-left corner.
sketch: Compute g = gcd of all maximal row runs and column runs. For each divisor k of g in decreasing order run the forced greedy: scan row-major, at an uncovered '#' stamp the k x k square, failing if it leaves the grid, hits '.', or hits an already stamped cell. Each test is O(hw) since every cell is stamped at most once; total O(d(g)*hw), about 0.5 s at 2500x2500. Use a stamp array keyed by k to avoid clearing. The overlap check is necessary because an earlier square from an upper row to the right can intrude into the new square. Stress-tested against trying every k.
